scope.compute: Measured on this machine using time.perf_counter_ns; not a dedicated edge device measurement.
scope.network: configured network emulation; not a measured public cloud

near_realtime_deadline.basis: operational deadline rounded from the original trace median inter-record gap of 3.5251918 seconds; not the legacy firmware nominal publish interval

workload.sample_selection: evenly spaced positions across all historical replay blocks
workload.role: monitoring-path latency, throughput, routing, provenance, legacy-proxy energy, occupancy, and multiscale Digital Twin replay

actual_local_monitoring.definition: Structural/electrical value checks, power-consistency check, routing, and payload construction on the local host.
actual_local_monitoring.validation_scope: Software-level structure and value checks only; not field validation or metrological validation of active power.

actual_edge_path.definition: local monitoring processing plus JSON serialization

parameters.label: configured network emulation; not a measured public cloud

configured_cloud_route_end_to_end.definition: Local monitoring plus serialization and configured network latency, calculated only for cloud-routed messages.
configured_cloud_route_end_to_end.warning: Network latency is configured, not field-measured.

configured_end_to_end.deadline_basis: operational deadline rounded from the original trace median inter-record gap of 3.5251918 seconds; not the legacy firmware nominal publish interval
configured_end_to_end.freshness_proxy: Processing plus configured network latency; browser rendering and historical age are excluded.
configured_end_to_end.warning: Network latency is configured, not field-measured.
configured_end_to_end.definition: Overall mixture of edge-routed and delivered cloud-routed messages; route composition affects its percentiles.

configured_cloud_only_baseline.definition: Counterfactual baseline in which every message traverses the same configured network profile after identical local processing and serialization.
configured_cloud_only_baseline.warning: Network latency is configured, not field-measured.

architecture_comparison.comparison_basis: Same replay sample, local processing, serialized payloads, seed, and configured network draws. This is a controlled emulation comparison, not a measured public-cloud trial.

routing.rule: Cloud for missing/non-finite values, invalid electrical readings, current below the legacy 0.1 A threshold, or legacy power above 42.6 W.
routing.basis: p99 legacy power in the original historical trace plus software rules for missing, non-finite, invalid electrical, and sub-0.1 A readings

data_quality.validity_definition: All required values are finite and electrical values satisfy the software bounds; this is not field validation.

legacy_proxy_energy.interpretation: Trapezoidal integral of the transformed CSV replay payload's legacy V×I field. This is workload context; the archived field-trace energy is calculated separately and no direct kWh-meter or power-factor channel is included.

throughput.definition: Messages divided by measured wall time for monitoring and serialization loop on this machine.
